title: Closet stats and outfit calculation
summary: Collection stats, class restrictions, visible points, and the literal outfit formula.
qualifiers: Source recommendations, first-person statements, and testing claims are Kanon’s. Figures are captured examples rather than universal costs or ideal builds.
Captured source update: 9/20/2026. Regional and unconfirmed details remain qualified as written.

content.text: The Closet (Transmog) system is another horizontal power system. As you unlock more skins you gain stats.This is a very longterm progression system.
Unlocking more skins will give you an increase in a % stat relative to the skin type. For example, unlocking more weapon skins will grant you an Attack Increase % specifically for your Weapon.

Let’s say the Attack from my Weapon, in this case my Fists (Gauntlet), is 500. Then 6.7% would be applied to the 500 if we were to go by the image above seeing as my Fist Attack Increase from my closet is +6.7%.
The 48% and 454/937 counts refer to Armor, not the whole Closet. Weapon skins for other classes do not contribute to collection points.
